new_statement: Allowed-input diagnosis for the proposed rectangular-product step: the literal pair (X^dagger,X) is nonsquare, and the canonical square zero-paddings B=Xe_1^* and A_0=B^dagger cannot repair the application under this shard's exact allowed inputs.
